recap: Cavaliers lost to the Pacers 126–118 in 2 overtimes.
Jaylon Tyson led the Cavaliers with 31 points (12-25 FG, 4-12 3PT), 7 rebounds and 4 assists.
Quenton Jackson led the Pacers with 21 points (7-16 FG, 0-4 3PT), 6 rebounds and 2 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 46.1 to 44.5.
Biggest swing: CLE offensive team rebound (OT 1:18), +18 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Okeke, Travers, Bates, Tomlin, Tyson, +11 in 12:23.
Bench points: CLE 35, IND 86. Points in the paint: 48–76. Second-chance points: 17–15.
